name: Steady 1200 rpm 10 min
description: Ten minutes at a constant 1200 rpm, after 30 s at rest. Unlike the staircase profiles this holds one operating point long enough for a stable spectrum and for drift to show: ~50 sweeps at the same speed instead of six. No temperature schedule - the heater is not driven and the Omron is left alone, so the rig cools freely through the run. NOTE when comparing against the RigCheck_5min recordings of 2026-09-02 morning: those were taken at 25-29 C, and UL falls markedly with temperature, so the bearing temperature logged in omron_pv_c must be carried into any comparison.
